# tfutils Provider

Resources that wait until a condition holds: on destroy, so that a controller is not removed before it finishes its cleanup, and on create, so that later resources do not call an endpoint before it is ready. AWS credentials come from `access_key`, `secret_key` and `token`, or from the AWS SDK default chain when they are not set. Use one provider alias per AWS account. The `tfutils_kubernetes_*` resources connect to the cluster in the `kubernetes` block; it accepts ephemeral values, so a token from an ephemeral resource stays out of the plan and state.

## Example Usage

```terraform
provider "tfutils" {
  region = "ap-northeast-2"
}

provider "tfutils" {
  alias  = "route53"
  region = "us-east-1"

  access_key = var.route53_access_key
  secret_key = var.route53_secret_key
  token      = var.route53_session_token
}

variable "cluster_token" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
  ephemeral = true
}

provider "tfutils" {
  alias = "cluster"

  kubernetes {
    host                   = module.eks.cluster_endpoint
    cluster_ca_certificate = base64decode(module.eks.cluster_certificate_authority_data)
    token                  = var.cluster_token
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `access_key` (String, Sensitive) AWS access key ID. Set together with `secret_key`.
- `kubernetes` (Block, Optional) Kubernetes API server used by the `tfutils_kubernetes_*` resources. The values may be unknown during plan, for example when the cluster is created in the same apply; the resources call the API server only during apply. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--kubernetes))
- `region` (String) AWS region of the resources to watch. Required by the `tfutils_aws_*` resources.
- `secret_key` (String, Sensitive) AWS secret access key. Set together with `access_key`.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) AWS session token for temporary credentials.

<a id="nestedblock--kubernetes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `kubernetes`

Optional:

- `cluster_ca_certificate` (String) PEM-encoded CA certificate of the API server. The system roots are used when it is not set.
- `host` (String) URL of the API server, for example `https://ABCD.gr7.ap-northeast-2.eks.amazonaws.com`. Required in the block.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Bearer token. When it is a JWT, the resources fail as soon as its `exp` passes instead of waiting for the timeout.
